h1: Sales dashboards that show what matters
overview: We build dashboards in your CRM that answer the questions you ask every Monday: how many deals are open, what is likely to close, where deals get stuck and who is doing what. Each chart has a plain title and a definition, so nobody argues about the numbers. We agree the measures with you first, build the views, check them against your records and show you how to filter by month, owner or source.

faq: Anything your CRM already records: deals, stages, owners, sources and activities. If a number needs data you do not collect yet, we tell you and suggest which field to add.
Do I need a paid CRM plan?
Custom dashboards are on paid plans for many CRMs. We check this first and tell you before we start. The plan fee goes to the CRM company, and our price covers the build.
Can I change the dashboards later?
Yes. We build them with standard CRM tools and show you how to edit filters and charts. For bigger changes, you can order again or choose a support service.
Will you connect other data sources?
These dashboards use data inside your CRM. Showing ad spend or store sales next to deals needs a connector, which we can quote separately after we see what your tools support.
